data.explanation: This letter confirms a new daily newspaper subscription starting 1 December 2026 at €42.50 per month, including the e-paper edition. The contract runs for an initial 12 months and can be cancelled with one month's notice to the end of that term; after that it can be cancelled any time with one month's notice. No action is required now unless you want to cancel later — the app will show the relevant notice deadline when the time comes.
